unitemized.reason: Only required for specs that 'look related'. Which specs are related cannot be observed, so no applies_when predicate can express the condition.

Conditional on 'each relevant spec'. Relevance is not observable, and no selector maps modified-capability deltas to existing spec ids to make reading them a requirement.

SHOULD-level quality guidance on spec content (observable behavior, inputs and outputs, constraints, testable scenarios). It is not deterministically checkable, and no scenario heading syntax is given in the cited lines.
Same check as schema-027 (openspec.capabilities listed_have_specs). Emitting it again would double-count.

Exact-path preservation is covered by listed_have_specs (schema-027), and confirming with `openspec list --specs` before the delta is covered by schema-020. A kebab-case path regex would be invented, not taken from the document.
